# Repository skills

Choose the skill that matches the main behavior being changed. When a task crosses boundaries, read both relevant skills and keep each responsibility in its established layer.

| Skill | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| [API integration](api-integration/SKILL.md) | Browser API endpoints, requests, response handling, rules, analysis scheduling, and API error states. |
| [Export and clipboard](export-and-clipboard/SKILL.md) | JSON, SARIF, Markdown, and text exports; clipboard and download fallbacks. |
| [Front-end design](front-end-design/SKILL.md) | Visual direction, layout hierarchy, imagery, motion, and substantial UI changes. |
| [GitHub Actions](github-actions/SKILL.md) | General workflow, CI, permission, trigger, action pin, and workflow-script changes. |
| [Kaseki automation](kaseki-automation/SKILL.md) | Kaseki task payloads, allowlists, scheduled callers, authenticated runs, and polling. |
| [Mermaid preview](mermaid-preview/SKILL.md) | Mermaid editing, type detection, preview rendering, parser errors, and source navigation. |
| [Next.js static export](nextjs-static-export/SKILL.md) | Next.js routing, component boundaries, static build output, and deployment configuration. |

For repository-wide conventions and required validation, also read [`../../AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md). The skills provide task-specific guidance and do not replace those instructions.
